# Bundle Opportunity Analysis

## Objective

Identify opportunities to improve low-performing product sales through product bundling strategies.

---

## Methodology

Products were ranked within each category based on total revenue.

For each category:

* Top-performing products were identified.
* Lowest-performing products were identified.
* Potential bundle candidates were generated by pairing products from the same category.

---

## Key Findings

Bundle opportunities were identified in several categories, including:

* Computer Accessories
* Health & Beauty
* Telephony
* Watches & Gifts
* Home Decoration

These categories contain products with large performance gaps between top sellers and low sellers.

---

## Business Value

Bundling strategies can help:

* Increase visibility of low-performing products
* Improve inventory turnover
* Increase average order value
* Strengthen cross-selling opportunities

---

## Recommendation

Pilot bundle campaigns using top-performing products as anchor products within their respective categories.

Monitor bundle conversion rates and evaluate incremental revenue generated through these campaigns.

---

## Conclusion

The analysis identified multiple category-level opportunities where product bundling may support both revenue growth and inventory optimization.
